curriculumRow: Урок 3, сессия 27 · тип: применение · грамматика: вопрос `Is this/that…?` · новые слова: remote, button, switch · момент сцены: уточняем назначение техники
cambridgeEvidence: Cambridge digest: this/that refer to singular objects, selected by distance from the speaker rather than ownership. Its required comparison places both forms together: That is a speaker → Is that a speaker? S27 applies the same known be-question movement to this and that. Every new noun is named and translated before its question phrase.
scene: At an interactive museum gallery, a technician shows the learner an unfamiliar exhibit control setup: a remote in hand, a button on the nearby console and a switch on the farther wall. The learner identifies each control before the exhibit is powered on.
